meta.rng: numpy default_rng (PCG64) via district_bootstrap.draw_counts; one (B x n_CZ) multiplicity matrix per partition shared by every statistic; resampling unit = whole CZ

tables.B25088_001/002/003: median selected monthly owner costs (all / mortgage / none)

ce_2018.source: BLS Consumer Expenditure Surveys, Table R-1 'All consumer units: Annual detailed expenditure means', 2018

meta.rp_definition: r_p = 12 x (dollar gap in monthly housing cost, suburb - city) / (mean annual expenditures per consumer unit, CE 2018)
meta.upper_bound_note: The whole level gap in housing spending includes quantity/quality and income-scaled (homothetic) differences and mortgage principal; treating it all as the fixed (non-homothetic) cost is an upper bound.

rp_range_locale_incl_owner_subsets: average owner costs without a mortgage, B25088_003 (b)
average of district medians, B25105, occupied-unit weights (b)
